scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ptq/shared && concurrently --kill-others -n shared,api,web "npm run dev -w @ptq/shared" "npm run dev -w @ptq/backend" "npm run dev -w @ptq/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ptq/shared && npm run build -w @ptq/backend && npm run build -w @ptq/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ptq/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
